title: Run FER simulation over AWGN for full DVB-T2 FEC chain
description:
## Goal

Execute the production AWGN simulation campaign using the binary
delivered by the BICM runner task (152388f4) for all 6
(rate × modulation) configurations required by the parent epic, and
check in the resulting CSV / PNG / tracing artefacts under
`dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`.

## Context

This is the terminal child of epic
`epic:dvb-t2-awgn-campaign` (2928ccce). All technical risk is
upstream (infrastructure, codec, interleaver, runner, validation).
This task is execution-only: plan the SNR sweeps, run the campaigns
(potentially several days of wall-clock), and curate the artefacts.

Resumability and structured tracing land via the infrastructure task
(fd73e8a8) so multi-day runs are safe to launch unattended.

## Deliverables

1. SNR sweep plan written to `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/PLAN.md`
   listing Es/N0 ranges per config, expected wall-clock, and the
   host the runs are executed on. Reviewed by lead before runs
   start.
2. For each of the 6 (rate × modulation) configurations:
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.csv`
   - `curve_<rate>_<mod>.png` (simulated vs ETSI TR 102 831 overlay,
     produced by the operator-run plotting script in
     `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`)
   - `tracing_<rate>_<mod>.jsonl`
3. `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/README.md` summarising results,
   invocation, total wall-clock, host info, and observed gap to the
   ETSI TR 102 831 reference for each curve.
4. Closure note quantifying the achieved gap per curve.

## Success criteria

- [hard] All 6 curves produced.
- [hard] Gap to ETSI TR 102 831 reference ≤ 0.5 dB at FER = 10⁻⁴ for
  each curve. If a curve cannot reach this gap, escalate per the
  amendment / escalation policy before closing.
- [aspirational] Achieve ≤ 0.3 dB at FER = 10⁻⁴ on each curve;
  recorded per curve in the closure note where met.
- [hard] ≥ 100 frame errors at each SNR point that brackets
  FER = 10⁻⁴.
- [hard] All artefacts committed under `dev/benchmarks/dvb_t2_awgn/`.
- [hard] PLAN.md and README.md present and complete.

## Non-goals

- No new code in this task. Any code change required would indicate
  an upstream slip — escalate rather than patch here.
- No fading channels.
